title: What a reconstruction-objective encoding drops
question: Can a covariate encoding learned to reconstruct the covariates drop an effect modifier while reconstructing them well, and would a declared mapping or the full covariate set avoid the resulting transport bias?
design: Twenty covariates with five strong and fifteen weak directions; the modifier on a strong or weak direction; STC on 2, 5 or 10 principal components, on all covariates, or on a declared modifier score, standardized to a shifted target. 12 cells, 1000 replicates each.
